concept: Roast Log: Bombay Island Coffee Company as a roaster's log sheet. Open on the Bombay Cafe Map logo, zoom the real 3D Mumbai map to Malad, cut to a glass-face roaster drum whose beans turn green to brown while a roast curve and temperature dial draw themselves, flip a signature menu card, glide a steam-thread route Malad to Vikhroli to Andheri West with progress rings, build a layered Tiramisu Cold Brew in cutaway and pull back to the brew bar, then drop a bean into the roaster hopper of the Bombay Island logo on the end card.

dimensions.palette: cafe's own charcoal #3F3A3A and teal #108474 with cool white #F4F7F6 and a lighter signal teal; beans keep natural colour; no orange, no cream
dimensions.fonts: Crimson Pro bold serif captions + Montserrat mono-style labels (the cafe's own site fonts)
dimensions.opening: Bombay Cafe Map logo big in frame 1, then top-down island-shape descent to Malad
dimensions.transition: roast-curve wipe: a teal heat-curve edge sweeps up the frame and the scene swaps behind it
dimensions.camera: top-down descent, then a 3/4 push-in on the drum, a cutaway side view of the glass, and a pull-back reveal
dimensions.layout: instrument-panel scenes: chart + dial panel under the drum, progress-ring plate left-aligned under the map pin, caption band with teal rule
motion_device: rotating roaster drum with bean colour shift
roast-curve line draw with temperature dial
progress ring fills while a fact is spoken
bean drop into the logo hopper
dimensions.texture: graph-paper roast log grid, brushed steel drum and glass, real OSM buildings
dimensions.sound: drum rumble, first-crack pops, ice and pour foley, soft pad, slow voice at most about 2.3 words per second
dimensions.ending: Bombay Cafe Map big card (same size as frame 1 so it loops) under the Bombay Island logo, a bean drops into the roaster hopper on the last word, follow and save prompts

experiment.hypothesis: A ring that fills while each fact is spoken (2018, 2021, 2026) gives the viewer a visible countdown to the next fact and should raise watch-through compared with static year labels.
